articles.title: A Baseball-Sized Robot That Turns Into a Moon Rover
articles.summary: SORA-Q, a rover about the size of a baseball, changed shape on the moon and photographed its lander's touchdown.

articles.title: A Visitor From Another Star Is Made of Dusty Ice
articles.summary: Telescope data show interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is made of tiny, dust-rich ice grains unlike our solar system's comets.

articles.title: An Antarctic Island Looks Like a Skull, and Its Ice Is Telling a Story
articles.summary: NASA images show Vega Island's skull shape, and far less snow in October 2026 than in March 2025.
